title: Understanding the Effect of Regularization
text: As the regularization parameter lambda approaches positive $$\infty$$, the model's complexity is heavily penalized. What does this imply for the coefficients of the model?

title: Impact on Coefficients
text: When lambda is very large, the penalty term in the regularization becomes dominant. How does this affect the values of the coefficients in the model?

title: Predictions with Large Lambda
text: Consider the effect of a large lambda on the predictions of the model. What happens to the predictions when the coefficients are driven towards zero?
choices: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
